text:
cheng: Quick heads-up — I'm opening a preflight thread for the sticky-residency rebalancing rollout planned tomorrow 09:00 PT. want a short checklist + callouts before we flip the flag.

tara: +1. main risks I see: eviction hysteresis causing hot prefixes to stick too long, and cascade when rebalancer kicks in.

ali: Agree. Also worried about fairness when small tenants compete with big tenants for slab credits. Need metrics for per-tenant eviction pressure.

mike: Can we do a tiny canary (5% nodes) with aggressive telemetry first? low blast radius.

cheng: Yes — proposed canary plan below. also adding a small config snippet for the sticky window.

cheng: ```yaml
sticky_residency:
  enabled: true
  window_ms: 120000   # 2m sticky window
  hysteresis_factor: 0.15
  fairness_mode: proportional
  fallback_policy: demote_immediate_on_oom
```

jen: Hysteresis 0.15 seems small. what was rationale?

cheng: Picked to avoid immediate churn on demote/reacquire for paged workloads. 0.15 reduces flip-flop, still allows demotion under memory pressure. open to tweak.

tara: We should add a guard: if eviction_rate > X we disable sticky on that node for Y minutes. avoids thrash.

ali: +1. Metric: `kv.evictions.per_min` and `kv.sticky_disabled_nodes` to alert. Also add a trace tag so we can correlate pre/post rebalancer ops.

mike: For canary: rollout buckets: 5% -> 20% -> 50% -> 100% with 30m observation windows. If any of these alerts fire, automated rollback.

cheng: I can wire the automated rollback via the rollout controller — config snippet: `rollout: {stages: [5,20,50,100], window_minutes: 30, auto_rollback: true}`

jen: Smoke test commands (devbox):
- `tools/kvctl simulate-workload --pattern hot-prefix-heavy --duration 10m`
- `kubectl logs -l app=kv --since=15m | grep sticky_residency`

evict-bot: [alert] simulated node OOM during local run (node-3). marking node-3 sticky_disabled=1 in test cluster.

mike: good catch from the bot. that's exactly why we need a guard. what about read latency tail? sticky might increase tail under evict churn. measure p99 read per-tenant.

tara: Also confirm rollback path: on rollback we must invalidate client-side pins and decrement residency counters gracefully. avoid double-demote.

cheng: Implementation note: we'll add a `residency_epoch` token per prefix so rollback can ignore stale tokens. that should prevent double-demote.

ali: One more: telemetry for fairness_mode `proportional` should emit per-slab-share percentages so we can tune formula.

jen: I'll own the smoke test runs + dashboard. putting smoke checklist in the PR description.

cheng: I'll open the rollout PR and include the canary/alert configs + the `residency_epoch` token change. tagging @jen @ali for review.

mike: If everyone is ok, I'll schedule the canary at 09:00 PT and stand by for 5% stage.

tara: ok from me. thanks for putting the guard rails together. :thumbsup:

cheng: thanks all. we should also add a short runbook snippet in incidents/ so SRE can manually cut sticky if needed. I'll draft that after PR lands.

ali: One optional follow-up: simulate multi-tenant noisy-neighbor scenario in chaos run (inject traffic from 1 large tenant) to see prefill + sticky interactions.

jen: added to checklist. will run chaos after 20% stage.

mike: noted. standing by tomorrow.

cheng: end of thread. will post PR link once it's up.
